cause_quote: The new restore path selected the owner with `if (entry !== batch[0])` and then called `reserveSubagentControllerSource(entry, identity.batchKey, undefined, caller, {` without checking whether any child execution in the batch was still current.
user_saw: After a Gateway restart restored a superseded child completion batch, new chat messages could stay on “Waiting for turn to start” indefinitely.
summary: The fix skips mailbox reservations for wholly obsolete batches and settles the full stored batch while delivering findings only from current child executions.
reasoning: The parent of #175837 already filtered superseded executions during wake revalidation, and its restart path did not reserve mailbox positions for restored completions. The reservation feature shipped with a mismatch: restore could reserve the full frozen batch, but preparation rejected it when the filtered list lacked a superseded member, leaving the reservation at the head of the queue. #177698 changed how restore selected the owner while retaining the same mismatch.
